description: Look up Argentina's official geography in Georef, the national government's reference service on datos.gob.ar. Search provinces, departments, municipalities, localities and streets with their official codes and centre points, turn a written address into its official form with coordinates, find the province, department and municipality of a point, and match place names as people write them, such as 'Bs As', to their official names, one at a time or a thousand at once. No account or API key required.
